mentions.name: Storenu
mentions.description: Commerce platform combining e-commerce, point of sale, and kitchen screens for product and service businesses, from yoga studios and salons to take-away restaurants and e-commerce shops; focused on Europe with a European payment processor, offering early users 0% transaction fees, with case-by-case onboarding while the live demo is not yet working.
mentions.audience: Owners of yoga studios, salons, take-away restaurants, and e-commerce shops in Europe
mentions.source_excerpt:
We are doing e-commerce, pos, kitchen-screen etc.
Both for product and services so from Yoga Studio/Salons to Take-away Restaurants or ecommerce shops.
However focussed only in Europe. Since we are working with a Europe payment processor and early users are getting 0% in transaction fees.
The live demo is still not working and we are onboarding on a case by case basis. https://storenu.com
